All three are run-time state bytes written by many routines (0x7c2ead: 35 references incl. 0x444e03/0x444e1e; 0x66d87c: 0x40b2a1/0x443996; 0x95404e: 0x4084e4/0x40fa3b/0x442baa), used only as bit masks and an equality test, so any byte is valid: 0x7c2ead is random, 0x66d87c mixes bit 7 set/clear, 0x95404e is 0xff in about a third of the cases and other values otherwise.
